text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Confirmation! Reports say you and several 
volunteers occupied an empty classroom to 
construct an attraction!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Machitan's Special: The Super-Exciting 
Haunted House of Plush Spiders and 
Ghosts"... That's right, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah—, well, umm, you see. It's kind of 
fooling around while not actually fooling 
around, or depending on how you look at 
it, this is training too...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Our dearest Chairwoman~! Please, 
please, have mercy on us~!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: No!! I shall show no leniency!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!! Waaah, I-I'll clean it up right 
aw—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Requesting an invitation! Please invite me 
to your mansion too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh! So that means... "no turning a blind 
eye, yes looking right at it"?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! Working together to create 
something, and truly enjoying one's 
leisure time... That is youth itself! I 
would dearly love to experience it as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I wish to know your idea of "ordinary"! 
Come, Tannhauser, lead the way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, I knew we could count on you, 
Chairwoman♪ All hail the Chairwoman of 
Chairwomen~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's play together to our 
hearts' content~♪ Table for one 
Chairwoman, right this waaaay!
